Buying a premium TV today means choosing between a dozen different technologies, but does it actually make your favourite shows and movies look and feel better? We take a close look at the LG QNED evo AI 4K MiniLED TV to find out.
In this video, we cover:
Mini LED display tech and what makes it different
LG's QNED Colour Tech and Alpha 8 Gen3 AI Processor

AI Concierge, AI Chatbot, and AI Picture and Sound Wizard
AI Brightness Control and AI Acoustic Tuning
